description: Unlock ONE person from a people_search result. Pass the `token` from that result. Spends 1 credit and returns the full profile: real name, current title and company, location and LinkedIn URL. Set `include_email` to true to also look up their verified professional (work) email in the same call, which spends 1 more credit that is refunded if no email is found. Revealing the same person again is free (idempotent). The email is looked up live and may take a moment: if it returns emailStatus 'searching', call reveal_profile again with the same token (no extra charge) to collect it.

include_email.description: Also fetch the person's verified professional email (a second credit, refunded if none is found). Default false.

token.description: The opaque `token` of a person returned by people_search.

name: reveal_profile
title: Reveal a person
